infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location stays on your phone. It is shared with your parent only when you turn sharing on, and it is never saved.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Only while you have started Share until I'm home or a heads-up session (at most 2 hours): your phone checks where you are to tell your family you arrived home. Your location stays on this phone and is never saved.
